search: Validation-search design, recorded cost and candidate rankings for the archived q19 sensitivity analysis. Run counts are unique saved tasks, including reused search-stage seeds, not a count of epochs or an equal-compute budget. Recorded seconds include model construction, fitting and validation/test prediction up to the timer stop; subsequent metric summaries and file writing are outside it. They are neither pure fit time nor GPU hours. XGBoost execution device is unrecorded. Epoch means and cap counts are not applicable to XGBoost. Candidate scores are validation RMSE for XGBoost/BiAttn/Trf and full-validation Gaussian CRPS for BU/BUAttn/ProbBi, in mm\,h$^{-1}$. The final column gives the three-seed mean only for the main-search top three; dashes mean not rechecked. BiAttn gate cap 30 is excluded from its 27-candidate cap-60 ranking. Abbreviations: BiAttn, BiLSTM-Attention; Trf, Transformer; BU, BU-LSTM; BUAttn, BU-LSTM-Attention; ProbBi, Probabilistic BiLSTM-Attention.
effects: Paired q19 A/B/C comparisons on 3,939 common test targets. A denotes original settings/cap: its references are q21 C0 for BiAttn, q14 W=6 reruns for the four light-search models, and q19 original-configuration reruns for XGB. These are not the complete original Table 3 run set. B changes only the epoch cap (60 for BiAttn, 100 for the other neural models); C uses validation-selected parameters at that extended cap. XGB has A=B; ProbBi has B=C, so the nonexistent C--B contrast is not invented. RMSE is reported for All, Wet ($y\geq0.1$) and Tail ($y\geq0.574048$, training Q95); Gaussian CRPS is evaluated on all targets only. Metric codes are R (RMSE) and C (Gaussian CRPS); row prefixes E and I identify the estimates and interval panels. Both scores are in mm\,h$^{-1}$. Values are means of seed-level scores; differences are newer minus reference, not scores of seed-mean predictions. Percent changes use the reference mean. $n_{\rm imp}$ counts seeds with a strictly smaller score; zero can indicate ties and does not automatically mean five deteriorations. Panel B intervals are pointwise 95\% seed-$t$ (four degrees of freedom) and paired non-circular moving-block percentiles (28 consecutive six-hourly samples, 5,000 replicates, seed 42, sampled indices truncated to 3,939). The same full-timeline indices are used across configurations/seeds before subset masks; within-seed differences are averaged. No multiplicity adjustment is made. Three-way improvement requires $n_{\rm imp}=5$ and both intervals wholly below zero; it is descriptive, not the archive\textquotesingle s medium/strong grading or a family-wise test. Model abbreviations follow Table~\ref{stab:r2m9_search}.
